content: Obhumwe bhwa abhiikirirya mu Krisito Yeesu
Ambe, enye omubhohwa kwiiguru yo okukora emirimo gyo Omukuru Yeesu, nirabhatoongera mwiikare mubhwiikari bhuno bhukweenderwa mumbirikiriro yino mukabhirikirirwa.
Eriibhaga ryoosi mubhe abhasuuku, abhanyoohu, mwiikongʼeereranie no okwiigegerana mubhuseegi.
Mukore omukya no okugeenderera no obhumwe bhuno bhukureetwa ne Ekoro Muhoreeru kwe enzira yo okwiikara kwo omureembe.
Etwe bhoosi ni mubhiri gumwe, na tukasuungʼaana Ekoro Muhoreeru, kyeego Taatabhugya yatubhirikiiri mubhwiisige bhumwe.
Kweeki tuno Omukuru wumwe, obhwiikirirya bhumwe no obhubatiizo bhumwe.
Twoosi turamuseengera Taatabhugya wumwe, niwe Taata weetu twoosi. Ewe ari iguru wa bhyoosi, arahokya emirimo kuhitira kweetwe twoosi na ariikara muusi weetu twoosi.
Nawe, etwe twoosi tuheerwe orubhaango kwe ekireengo kyaaye omweene kwo obhuturo bhwa Krisito. Akasoondya obhuturo bhuyo kyeego omweene akeenda.
Nikyo Amakaamo Amahoreeru gakubhuga,
Ambe, eriingʼana riyo, “Akagegwa iguru,” obhugazuro bhwaku niki? Obhugazuro bhwaku ni kubhuga, hano Krisito yaari akyaari kugegwa iguru akataanga okwiituuma tee mukyaaro?
Yeesu niwe akiituuma mukyaaro hano, niwe akagya kuhita amasaaro goosi, okubha yiizure mukyaaro kyoosi.
Ewe niwe akatuura abhaandi kubha abheega, na abhaandi kubha abharooti na abhaandi abharwaazi bha Amangʼana Amazomu, na abhaandi kubha abhariisya na abheegya.
Akakora ego, okubha abhone okubhanura abhaatu abhahoreeru okukora emirimo gya Krisito, okubha omubhiri gwa Krisito guzaame.
Engʼana yiyo, erageenderera tee hano etwe turaabhe abhamwe mubhwiikirirya bhweetu, no okumumenya Omwaana wa Taatabhugya. Turabha abhaatu bhano bhakongʼiri kya Krisito.
Ambe, tutakunagya kubha kya abhaana abharere, turataaswataaswa eno ne eyo no okugegwa no obhukama bhwa ameegyo go omukoonyo gwa abhaatu, kwo orurimi rwaabhu, kwo okutuniirira ameegyo go orurimi.
Nawe, tubhe turiibhuurira obhuheene kubhuseegi, tubhe tugumiiri mumangʼana goosi, naabhe turiingʼaane na Krisito. Ewe niwe omukaangati iguru wa bhyoosi no omutwe gwa abhiikirirya.

Ewe aragwaatania abhaatu bhaaye bhoosi no okubha abhamwe, na arabhigwaatania hamwe kye ebhiimo bhyo omubhiri. Na ebhiimo bhyoosi hano bhikukora emirimo gyaku bhwaheene, omubhiri gwoosi gurakiina no okubha muzomu kwo obhuseegi.
Mubhe abhaatu abhahya
Kweego kwo obhuturo bhuno Omukuru Yeesu akaaniha, nirabhatoongera kubha, okweemera bhoono mutiikara kya abhaatu bhano bhatamumenyiri Taatabhugya kyeego bhakwiikara, kwo obhubhi bhwa amiiseego gaabhu.
Abhaatu bhayo, obhwoongo bhwaabhu bhuri mukiirima, na bhaahwiirwe kure no obhuhoru bhwa Taatabhugya, kwiiguru yo obhugeege bhwaabhu no obhukongʼu bhwe eziikoro zyaabhu.
Kweego bhatakurora soni, bhariisikirya mumakire, no okuseega kukora amangʼana amabhiihu gano gatakweenderwa.
Nawe emwe, muteegiibhwe ego Amangʼana gayo ga Krisito.
Nino obhuheene kubha, mukiigwa amangʼana ga Yeesu no okweegibhwa amangʼana ge eheene kwiiguru waaye.
Mukeegibhwa kubha, mutige eziiteemo zyeenyu zye ekare. Eriibhaga rirya mwaari murasarika kwo okukaangiriribhwa ne eziinaamba zyeenyu.
Na mukeegibhwa kubha, mukorwe bhuhya muziikoro na mumiiseego geenyu,
mubhe abhaatu abhahya bhano muteemirwe kwe etuubho ya Taatabhugya, mubhe murakora ge eheene na mugaambe obhuheene no obhuhoreeru.
Kweego mutige orurimi, nawe mugaambe eheene kumuutu wuyo woosi, kwo okubha turi bhiimo bhyo omubhiri gumwe.
Hano mukutiinda, mutakora ebhibhi, naabhe mutiikara no obhururu tee hano eryoobha rikutubhira,
naabhe mutamuha Seetaani omweeya.
Omwiibhi atiibha kweeki, nawe omuutu we eteemwa yiyo ereenderwa akore emirimo emizomu kwa amabhoko gaaye, abhone ekigiro kyo okumusoondera wuno ataanakyo.
Amangʼana amabhi gatarwa muminwa gyeenyu, nawe gabhe mazomu kwiiguru yo okubhasakirya abhaandi, kuriingʼaana no obhweendi bhwaabhu. Kweego, bhano bhakubhiigwa gabhasakirye.
Mutamukorera Ekoro Muhoreeru wa Taatabhugya ebhigoongi, wuno emwe mukabhaaswa orubhaaso kwiiguru yo orusiku rwo obhutuurya.
Muruusye obhutiindi, obhururu, obhuhaari, eriiyoge, amatuki ne eziiteemwa eziimbi zyoosi.
Mubhe murakorerana bhuzomu, mubhe ne ebhigoongi, na mwaabhirane kyeego Taatabhugya abhaabhiiri emwe kwe enzira ya Krisito.
